stem:
Anaya watches a rabbit eat cabbage leaves under a shady verandah. She asks how the rabbit is linked to the Sun's energy.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Cabbage leaves use sunlight to make food that supplies energy to the rabbit.
The rabbit gets the Sun's energy indirectly by eating the cabbage leaves.
When the rabbit eats cabbage, energy passes from the rabbit to the cabbage.
The rabbit eating cabbage in the shade gets no energy linked to the Sun.

teacher.key_rationale: Plants make food using sunlight; animals get that energy by eating plants. Energy does not flow from rabbit to cabbage. Shade does not cut the link through plant food.
